entities.summary: Gerd-Klaus Kaltenbrunner was an Austrian writer and publisher associated with the German New Right of the 1970s. He promoted what he called "creative conservatism", which he defined as future-oriented and revolutionary in its theory. Gerd-Klaus Kaltenbrunner was a philosophers & thinkers from Vienna (1939-02-23, Vienna–2011-04-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
